1.pickthall: Rivalry in worldly increase distracteth you
1.yusuf_ali: The mutual rivalry for piling up (the good things of this world) diverts you (from the more serious things),
1.muhammad_sarwar: The desire to have more of the worldly gains have pre-occupied you so much (that you have neglected remembring God),
1.mohsin_khan: The mutual rivalry for piling up of worldly things diverts you,

2.pickthall: Until ye come to the graves.
2.shakir: Until you come to the graves.
2.muhammad_sarwar: until you come to the graves.
2.mohsin_khan: Until you visit the graves (i.e. till you die).
2.arberry: even till you visit the tombs.

3.sahih_international: No! You are going to know.
3.pickthall: Nay, but ye will come to know!
3.yusuf_ali: But nay, ye soon shall know (the reality).
3.mohsin_khan: Nay! You shall come to know!
3.arberry: No indeed; but soon you shall know.

4.sahih_international: Then no! You are going to know.
4.pickthall: Nay, but ye will come to know!
4.shakir: Nay! Nay! you shall soon know.
4.muhammad_sarwar: You shall cetainly know (about the consequences of your deeds).
4.mohsin_khan: Again, Nay! You shall come to know!
4.arberry: Again, no indeed; but soon you shall know.

5.sahih_international: No! If you only knew with knowledge of certainty...
5.pickthall: Nay, would that ye knew (now) with a sure knowledge!
5.yusuf_ali: Nay, were ye to know with certainty of mind, (ye would beware!)
5.shakir: Nay! if you had known with a certain knowledge,
5.muhammad_sarwar: You will certainly have the knowledge of your deeds beyond all doubt.
5.mohsin_khan: Nay! If you knew with a sure knowledge (the end result of piling up, you would not have occupied yourselves in worldly things)
5.arberry: No indeed; did you know with the knowledge of certainty,

6.sahih_international: You will surely see the Hellfire.
6.shakir: You should most certainly have seen the hell;
6.mohsin_khan: Verily, You shall see the blazing Fire (Hell)!

7.sahih_international: Then you will surely see it with the eye of certainty.
7.pickthall: Aye, ye will behold it with sure vision.
7.yusuf_ali: Again, ye shall see it with certainty of sight!
7.shakir: Then you shall most certainly see it with the eye of certainty;
7.muhammad_sarwar: and you will see it with your own eyes.
7.mohsin_khan: And again, you shall see it with certainty of sight!
7.arberry: Again, you shall surely see it with the eye of certainty

8.sahih_international: Then you will surely be asked that Day about pleasure.
8.pickthall: Then, on that day, ye will be asked concerning pleasure.
8.yusuf_ali: Then, shall ye be questioned that Day about the joy (ye indulged in!).
8.shakir: Then on that day you shall most certainly be questioned about the boons.
8.muhammad_sarwar: Then, on that day, you will be questioned about the bounties (of God).
8.mohsin_khan: Then, on that Day, you shall be asked about the delight (you indulged in, in this world)!
8.arberry: then you shall be questioned that day concerning true bliss.
